searchText: Heya everybody! My name Is Paul (pablosan). I have been doing a lot of reading on eth2 with the intention of becoming a validator. I'm working through the Eth2 Hacker Start information on ethereum.org and hoping to get involved in testing efforts. I'm just doing this in my spare time so my progress may be a bit slow. I'm very excited about everything I'm reading about Casper FFG, PoS, Sharding, etc. Hey <@296672161811398657>, welcome! Are you interested in development, or just want to learn about all this first? I highly recommend https://hackmd.io/@benjaminion/eth2_info as a place to start learning Hi <@!203220829473996800>! I may be interested in development, but planning to start out just seeing if I can figure out how to get a client (at least the beacon) running locally. Thanks for the link. I've read several of the items in that list (e.g. all of the Ethereum "Validated, staking..." blog entries). Nice, that's a great start I'm now looking at the different clients with a preference for Prysm or Trinity (Python is currently my strongest language, and I also have some Golang experience). I see Prysmatic has their own testnet. Is their testnet only usable with their client? Or maybe a better question, assuming their are multiple testnets: how do I choose one? Hi <@!296672161811398657> Raul from the Prysm team here. You can get started running a node https://prylabs.net/participate. Our testnet is for now, Prysm only, but we will be restarting it soon to match the latest spec version which will be interoperable with other clients. You can also check out our documentation here: https://docs.prylabs.network Perfect. Thank you! Looking now... You can join our discord if you have any questions https://discord.gg/6zQrMeH
